components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--n-3); border-radius: 10px; font-family: Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--n-7); text-decoration: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), border-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--n-7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { border-color: var(--n-7); color: var(--n-0); background: var(--n-7); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #000; background: #000; } .ds-btn-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-dot { background: var(--accent); }

components.css: .ds-case { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(150px, 42%) 1fr; gap: 24px; max-width: 560px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--n-white); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--n-2), 0 1px 2px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.04); font-family: Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 240ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-case:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--n-7), 0 18px 40px -20px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.3); } .ds-case-ground { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 22px; border-radius: 12px; background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 8%, #fff 0%, var(--n-1) 58%, #e9e9e9 100%); } .ds-screen { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 9 / 16; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--n-1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.08), 0 1px 2px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.06), 0 12px 32px -12px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.28); } .ds-case-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 12px 12px 12px 0; } .ds-case-name { margin: 0; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--n-7); } .ds-case-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; margin: 14px 0 28px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--n-5); } .ds-case-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--n-3); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--n-7); } .ds-panel { margin: auto 0 0; } .ds-panel-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--n-2); } .ds-panel dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--n-5); } .ds-panel dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--n-7); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-delta { margin-left: 6px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--n-5); }

components.name: Case Index
components.description: Floating white table of every case, each row an anchor to its card.
components.css: .ds-index { margin: 0; max-width: 520px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--n-white); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--n-2), 0 2px 4px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.03), 0 32px 64px -32px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.28); font-family: Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-index-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--n-2); font-weight: 500; color: var(--n-7); } .ds-muted { color: var(--n-5); font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-index-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 27px minmax(0, 1fr) auto 32px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 20px; color: var(--n-6); text-decoration: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--n-1); transition: background-color 140ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-index-row:hover { background: var(--n-0); } .ds-index-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--n-7); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-index-thumb { width: 27px; height: 48px; border-radius: 4px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 5px, rgb(17 17 17 / 0.06) 5px 6px), var(--n-1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.08); } .ds-index-name { font-weight: 500; color: var(--n-7); } .ds-num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
A monochrome product-marketing world (catalog id `digital-design-canon-monochrome-product-marketing`) where each ad is treated like a product on a plinth: a 9:16 screen set on a soft radial ground, with its proof in a hairline-ruled panel beside it. The interface itself is gray from #fafafa paper to #111 ink; every saturated pixel on the page belongs to the creatives. Satoshi in two weights carries everything in sentence case, and numbers are always tabular.

Density is calm and even. Cases sit in an equal two-column grid with no hero case, so the eye compares like with like. Depth is quiet and physical: white surfaces lifted by a one-pixel ring and a long, low ambient shadow, and gray grounds lit from above by radial gradients. A single chartreuse accent marks the moments that matter (the primary action, the account-average marker, the case you navigated to) and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral-only chrome; color comes from the work.
Creatives framed as 9:16 screens on radial light grounds.
Hairline-ruled metric panels with tabular numerals and parenthetical deltas.
Ghost buttons by default; one solid ink primary with a chartreuse dot.
Ring-plus-ambient shadows instead of borders on lifted surfaces.
Soft rise-in motion on a long ease-out curve.

rules.name: The Work Is The Color Rule
rules.body: The interface never introduces a hue of its own beyond chartreuse. Saturated color on a page must come from an ad creative.

rules.name: The Four Signals Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse appears only as a small dot or marker, never as a fill, text color, or background panel, and only where it marks action, benchmark, or arrival.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 500 exist. Hierarchy comes from size, tracking, and the ink-versus-muted color split, never from bold.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons, tags, and table heads are sentence case. No uppercase labels, no letter-spaced small caps.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared (metrics, deltas, days, counts) is set in tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Ring Not Border Rule
rules.body: Lifted surfaces are edged with a 1px spread shadow, not a border. Borders are reserved for controls (buttons, tags) and structural rules.

rules.name: The Lit Ground Rule
rules.body: A creative or a showcase panel sits on a radial gradient that is brightest near the top, never on a flat fill.

dos: Do keep chrome on the neutral scale (#fafafa paper to #111 ink) and let creatives supply color.
Do frame every creative as a 9:16 screen on a top-lit radial ground.
Do set every comparable number in tabular numerals, with account-relative deltas in parentheses at a smaller, muted size.
Do edge lifted white surfaces with a 1px hairline ring shadow and give lift with a long negative-spread ambient shadow.
Do default to ghost buttons; reserve the solid ink button with its chartreuse dot for the contact action.
Do give peer cases equal size and weight in an even grid.
donts: Don't use chartreuse as a fill, text color, or surface; it is a dot or marker only.
Don't introduce weights beyond 400 and 500, or uppercase, letter-spaced labels.
Don't single out one case with a larger card or hero treatment when cases are peers.
Don't place a creative on a flat fill or without its screen frame.
Don't add hues to UI chrome (colored badges, tinted panels, gradient text).
